options.name: Now
options.line: The footer as it is: a headline, an outlined link and three columns of small print.

options.name: Last Light
options.line: The whole room is the last picture. It is dark and close as you arrive and the lights come up as it fills the screen.

options.name: Open Strings
options.line: Six strings run across the page and ring when a hand crosses them. Sound is there too, switched off until asked for.

options.name: The Ticket
options.line: A paper appointment card: pick the guitar, the day and the hour, and it is stamped.
